findings.description: A viewer can save changes to an existing expense: a POST to /expenses/1 as the viewer returns 303 'updated' and overwrites the title and amount (Train to Pune $42.50 became HACK $1.00), so the viewer's role can change data that only editors should edit.
repro: Open /expenses/1/edit (returns 200 with the full edit form, not 403)
POST title=HACK, category=travel, amount=1 to /expenses/1 (the form's action)
Observe 303 to /expenses?flash=updated and the list now shows HACK $1.00; total drops by $41.50

findings.description: The edit page renders the full editable form for a viewer (200 with title, category and amount inputs and a Save button), while the viewer's /expenses/new returns 403 and the list hides Edit links; the edit page should be forbidden to viewers too.
repro: Observe the Edit expense form with a Save expense button

findings.description: When the category filter is applied, the list shows only the filtered rows but the Total still sums every expense (e.g. travel shows 3 rows totalling $185.25 but the Total reads $399.99).
repro: Observe three rows summing to $185.25 and Total: $399.99

findings.description: Authenticated HTML pages are served without anti-framing or content-type hardening headers (no Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options or X-Content-Type-Options), leaving the app open to clickjacking.
repro: Observe no CSP, X-Frame-Options or X-Content-Type-Options headers

notes: Tested: login, both roles' lists and totals, category filter, route access (new/edit/detail/404), viewer POST writes, editor create/edit/delete, validation (negative, 3dp, blank title), escaping of HTML in titles, response times (all under 120 ms). Side effects on shared data: expense 1 was overwritten by the viewer (f1) and remains as HACK $1.00; test row 9 was deleted; expense 2 was restored to 68.40. Session cookie is httpOnly and SameSite=Lax but not Secure (plain HTTP target, not reported).

cost.notes: estimate from 25664 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0003-$0.0031
